summary: Social app with user profiles, including profile photo, banner, and edit profile functionality.
known_issues: Save Profile throws 'failed to update profile' error — backend profile update call is failing

existing_features.title: Fix the 'failed to update profile' error that occurs when a user taps the Save button in the Edit Profile modal. The backend profile update call must succeed and persist changes (name, handle, bio, location, profile photo) correctly.
Fix the banner upload/change button on the profile page so it is fully functional. Users must be able to tap the banner button, select an image, and have it displayed as the profile banner.

projectName: Fix Save Profile error and banner button functionality
